scope: Independent bounded resident-file inspection of benchmark evidence, version distinctions, test definitions and proposed plan. No project code was executed.

checks.finding: All six receipt hashes and sizes match resident originals. Selected week, local-day, transport, final-closeout and verification fields match. HOST_FINAL selected domain fields match the source model subobjects; weather_staging is a renamed selection of weather_staging_state.

Week receipt identifies native f4d4690c773bea1b4e552be0ccf2bcdc6947e68dc58530ed5dcdceb786f0e8fc. Local-day receipt and resident v3 BUILD_EXPORT identify native ee65c7748c4d2a7e9f3900fc3a5e8c16c045db90eb34a9b877b7bcc5dc942132 and middleware 09b65b5c2a76df4e8e9b334b9d3c56f39c327955306085cae692484742dcc162. The dossier correctly prevents the older week tolerance result from automatically qualifying a current public rebuild.

Week receipt uses math.isclose with abs_tol=1e-6 and rel_tol=1e-5. Each gauge has 3024 keyed rows and zero tolerance failures; nonzero differences at two gauges preclude a universal bitwise-identity claim. Two domains and three gauge outputs are distinguished correctly.

1213/490 = 2.4755102041 is an unequal-resource whole-workflow ratio. Domain wrapper timings, 24/8-vCPU allocations, configured 11/3 child caps and observed 3/2 outstanding peaks match the receipt. Production times and quotas match model subobjects. No equal-resource algorithmic speedup, peak whole-job PSS, CPU-hour normalization or invoice claim is made.

Local-day receipt explicitly disclaims portable land-state recovery. Transport records model_runs=0 and accounted, not independently measured transfer bytes. Final storage counts are reported as historical receipt values without a new archive recount. Weather staging bytes do not establish preprocessing throughput.

Read the cited sections of six resident test modules without importing or executing them. Linux /proc and compiler guards, pinned-source skips, synthetic runtime fixtures, weather validation, cursor crash and owned-process cleanup assertions support the source-definition descriptions. The dossier correctly does not assert a new passing-test count.

Proposed cases cover fixed-workload reference equivalence, equal-resource concurrency, child/host failure, missing and corrupt inputs, two domain contexts and independent reproduction. Public fixture and retained-input dependencies are disclosed; cases are clearly proposed and unrun. Avoiding artificially expensive per-issue history reconstruction in the baseline is appropriate.

optional_improvements.suggestion: Add explicit source JSON pointers for normalized HOST_FINAL fields: domain_receipts/<domain>.FINAL.json/model/<field> and weather_staging_state/<field>. Their values are correct, but selected_fields currently flattens model and renames weather_staging_state without recording that mapping.

limitations: Historical receipt assertions were checked for faithful representation, not rerun or independently reconstructed from complete raw arrays and event streams.
No model, native build, test suite, project script, cloud/network operation, archive download or dataless-file hydration was performed.

Detailed runtime implementation claims in STATE_AND_RECOVERY.md were not exhaustively source-audited in this benchmark lane.
